provenance_review.finding: The summary and representative indexed artifacts are intact. The repaired local executable and DSOs are a different identity from the preserved deployed bundle, and absent template/configuration identity is correctly rejected rather than borrowed from historical evidence.

goal_checks.finding: The phase-23 JSON SHA-256 is 0809c8eb91aaf703a5dbc0d595ec6e02263ad4c0c5e0aa39c6a9f9f132060af1; its common contract passes and all 22 independently sampled index entries match.
The repaired candidate was not deployed, its binary differs from the preserved runtime, and phase 23 has neither a repaired runtime template hash nor a configuration hash.
Only deterministic 262144-token geometry was measured. Automatic production allocation and the requested 262136-token occupied population were not run, so the composite base gate failed.
No repaired production run emitted canonical host-valid Turbo4 rows or bytes at near-full occupancy.
Admission/retry fixtures passed, but no production allocation reported a reconciled byte ledger, derived hot pages, physical pool charge, or warmup peak.

The fake multi-page transaction measured candidate selection, H2D construction, publication and rollback, but no production query linked a cold logical page through checksum, event/fence, slot/generation, route and answer.
No fresh 262144-context allocation observed native MTP K/V as Turbo4, exactly 262144 rows, and GPU residency through occupied-context continuation.
Production selected-all and exact denominators are both zero; no cold-page identity chain or full-context lossless result exists.
All 72 planned exact, selected-all and selective requests remained unexecuted, and the frozen corpus contains no multi-hop family.
No repaired-bundle soak segment ran, so movement correlation, churn, cancellation/drain, checkpoint restore, restart, slot reuse, and resource plateau are absent.
The six-point curve has zero target rows and controls have zero pairs. No speed ratio or component bottleneck is measurable; 3x/5x/70% remain annotations only.
The optional stretch was correctly skipped because the base goal was not demonstrated and does not affect the verdict.

quality_result.interpretation: No quality or reversible sparsity tradeoff can be scored from a zero denominator.

performance_result.speed_verdict: No actual phase-23 curve or bottleneck decomposition exists. The historical comparison targets are findings, not gates, and are not used as substitutes.
performance_result.historical_threshold_policy: 3x/5x CPU-KV and 70% all-GPU comparisons remain annotations, not pass gates.

verdict_reason: Phase 23 validates several deterministic repairs but does not deploy their coherent product bundle. Every hard live requirement—262144 occupied context, CPU-canonical backing, derived hot pages, GPU Turbo4 MTP, production cold retrieval, parity, quality, soak, and speed/control rows—either failed as a composite gate or was not measured.

ranked_gaps.gap: No benchmark-owned immutable repaired deployment or complete telemetry preflight.
ranked_gaps.hypothesis: The phase-23 cascade stopped because no task owned a safe lifecycle transition and immutable executable-plus-DSO launch; once ownership, staging and telemetry are one atomic preflight, downstream requests can run without mixing the preserved runtime.
